hours.inaccessibleText: RCFC 6(a): the clerk's office is inaccessible during the last hour; extend to the same time on {date}
hours.rollText: RCFC 6(a): the period ends on a weekend or legal holiday; continue to the same time on {date}
hours.text: RCFC 6(a): count every hour from the trigger; +{n} hour(s)

months.text: RCFC 6(a): count {n} {unit} {after} the anchor to the corresponding day, else the last day of that month -> {date}

periods.text: RCFC 6(a): count {n} calendar day(s) {after} the anchor -> {date}
RCFC 6(a): count {n} court day(s) {forward}, skipping weekends and holidays -> {date}
RCFC 6(a): count {n} business day(s) {forward}, skipping weekends and holidays -> {date}

backward.text: RCFC 6(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

forward.text: RCFC 6(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

steps.backwardText: RCFC 6(a): service extensions apply to forward periods only; ignored

backward.text: RCFC 6(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

forward.text: RCFC 6(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

steps.ignoredText: RCFC 6(a): no inaccessibility extension applies; ignored
steps.text: RCFC 6(a): the clerk's office is inaccessible on the last day; extend -> {date}
